hotel.name: Frasers House Singapore, a Luxury Collection Hotel

verified_facts.text: The hotel is in Singapore's Bugis district.
verified_facts.excerpt: Dive into a world of heritage and class at Frasers House, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Singapore, in the bustling Bugis district.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is steps from the Bugis MRT station.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located just 20 minutes from Changi Airport and steps from the Bugis MRT station

verified_facts.text: Bugis once thrived as a quarter of artisans, tailors, goldsmiths, woodcarvers and perfumers.
verified_facts.excerpt: Bugis once thrived as a quarter of artisans, tailors, goldsmiths, woodcarvers, and perfumers along North Bridge Road, Hylam Street, and Malabar Street.

verified_facts.text: Each space in the hotel reinterprets a trade once found in Bugis, such as the glassblower's bar, the perfumer's lounge and the silversmith's salon.
verified_facts.excerpt: each space reinterprets a trade once found here: the glassblower’s bar, the perfumer’s lounge, the silversmith’s salon

verified_facts.text: Guests can choose between light-filled rooms in the Main Tower or the Heritage Wing, inspired by traditional Singapore shophouse living.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests may choose between light-filled rooms in the Main Tower or the intimate character of the Heritage Wing, inspired by traditional Singapore shophouse living.

verified_facts.text: Heritage Wing rooms and suites draw on Singapore's historic shophouses and Peranakan heritage, with timber flooring and ornate furnishings.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set within the Heritage Wing, these guest rooms and hotel suites draw inspiration from Singapore’s historic shophouses and Peranakan heritage. Timber flooring, ornate furnishings

verified_facts.text: The Classic Room features bespoke furnishings, a bathtub and a separate walk-in shower.
verified_facts.excerpt: this luxury hotel room features bespoke furnishings, a bathtub and a separate walk-in shower

verified_facts.text: The Presidential Suite has a dining room that seats up to 12 guests and an ensuite bathroom with a private sauna.
verified_facts.excerpt: alongside a dedicated study and an elegant dining room that seats up to 12 guests, ideal for private gatherings or business entertaining. Completing the experience is a spacious ensuite bathroom with a private sauna

verified_facts.text: The Family Suite has a dedicated kids' themed area with bunk beds, a slide and a play zone.
verified_facts.excerpt: The 52 sqm suite features a dedicated kids’ themed area with bunk beds, a slide and a play zone

verified_facts.text: The Curated Sensory Journey, guided by the Concierge team, explores Kampong Glam through sight, taste, sound, scent and touch.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Curated Sensory Journey invites guests to experience Kampong Glam through sight, taste, sound, scent, and touch

verified_facts.text: The Curated Sensory Journey is complimentary for in-house guests.
verified_facts.excerpt:
Complimentary for in-house guests

Duration: Every Saturday

verified_facts.text: Each afternoon, guests can taste signature cookies reinterpreting laksa, chicken rice and ondeh ondeh, paired with TehKita.
verified_facts.excerpt: Signature cookies reinterpret beloved local flavours such as laksa, chicken rice and ondeh ondeh, paired with TehKita

verified_facts.text: The Maker's Serambi is a bi-monthly showcase of handcrafted works by artisans, makers and creators.
verified_facts.excerpt: bringing together artisans, makers and creators through a showcase of handcrafted works

verified_facts.text: Guests can unwind by the outdoor swimming pool and use a spacious fitness center with tailored wellness programs.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests can unwind by the outdoor swimming pool and rejuvenate in our spacious fitness center featuring tailored wellness programs

verified_facts.text: The Executive Lounge has warm timber floors, louvered windows and curated furnishings.
verified_facts.excerpt: Warm timber floors, louvered windows and curated furnishings reflect the hotel

verified_facts.text: Dining spans Cantonese cuisine at Man Fu Yuan and Italian cuisine at LUCE.
verified_facts.excerpt: from Cantonese tradition at Man Fu Yuan to Italian expressions at LUCE

verified_facts.text: Chikuyotei, the hotel's Japanese restaurant, specializes in unagi, omakase and a la carte.
verified_facts.excerpt: specializes in Unagi, Omakase and a la carte

verified_facts.text: Parking for hotel guests is at Bugis Junction Carpark.
verified_facts.excerpt: Parking for guests of Frasers House is at Bugis Junction Carpark.

unresolved.text: Man Fu Yuan is described as an award-winning Cantonese restaurant.
